featured_reviews.name: Sagar Jondhale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited B M Juice Centre and tried their mango juice and beetroot juice. Both drinks were refreshing and delicious in their own unique ways.

The mango juice was a standout. It was incredibly smooth and bursting with fresh, ripe mango flavor. The sweetness was perfectly balanced, not overpowering, which made it very enjoyable. It felt like drinking the essence of summer in a glass.

The beetroot juice was also impressive. It had a vibrant color and a fresh, earthy taste that was both healthy and refreshing. The natural sweetness of the beetroot was nicely highlighted, making it a great choice for a nutritious drink.

Overall, B M Juice Centre provided a great juice experience with high-quality ingredients and excellent flavors. I highly recommend trying their juices if you're looking for a refreshing and healthy treat.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer of their Valencia Orange for a good 4-5 months and I was pretty happy with the quality and purity of the juices.

But now, the composition of the juice has changed. It’s no longer 100% Valencia Orange Juice.The labels and on the bottle has also changed. There’s barely any pulp in it. The shelf life has increased to 3 months now compared to  45 days and the juice just doesn’t taste the same anymore. It feels adulterated. featured_reviews.name: S P
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been purchasing Raw Pressery juices for over a year and it's been a mostly good experience. However, over the last 1 month (end of May - June), I noticed two problems: (1) When I opened the juice bottles, they had a distinct stink at the rim. It is the kind of smell that lingers after using dirty dish water. In other words, I get the impression their bottles are not being cleaned and prepared under the right hygiene conditions at the processing plant. Reminds me of the roadside stalls where they dunk used utensils and cutlery into buckets of muddy-looking water. It's an awful sour smell that just ruins the whole experience of consuming an apparently fresh, healthy juice. And (2) The Orange juice has an awful after-taste. Almost like crocin or some sort of medication, may be even pesticide, has been crushed into it. I suspect the oranges are not being washed or scrubbed properly before they're juiced. Together, these two reasons have compelled me to stop purchasing Raw Pressery juices. To be sure of the quality, I bought juice bottles from 4 separate locations / businesses in the city. Unfortunately, I encountered the same problem. I complained to one of the business owners and have also shared my experiences with friends and family. The price point of the products is high (or at least not affordable for most / many), and the company is profiting from the idea of consciousness and purity -- for these reasons, it is extremely important that they observe the strictest product quality controls. I have communicated my concerns to the company and hope they take the necessary measures to fulfill their commercial promise of delivering an excellent product.
